questions.question: A, B, C, D, G, H and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. G sits to the immediate left of D. B sits to the immediate left of C. C sits second to the left of A. I sits third to the left of D. Who sits third to the right of H?
questions.solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, G, H and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) G sits to the immediate left of D.

2) I sits third to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b241f5eaa7d6be93ff3d0e1c42cddea7e83ddb09602aa93041b6ea6b02343bb.png] 

3) B sits to the immediate left of C. 

4) C sits second to the left of A.

After positioning A, C and B only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/324b8a5b37347f3d7f80e3e99cbeea388e0e9c6c2d6dc97e927e57a62509f651.png] 

Thus, I sits third to the right of H.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

 Statements:

 All fruit are bananas.

 Some bananas are green.

 All green are leaves.

 Conclusions:

 (I) Some fruits are bananas.

 (II) Some green are leaves.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2646172756235aa9b14d88f0f68d731e201aaa801bd8d8b33442464e5dfe02ac.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some fruits are bananas → Follow (As all fruit are bananas. As whole fruits comes in bananas, therefore it is true.)

(II) Some green are leaves → Follow (As all green are leaves. As whole green comes in leaves, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.solution:

questions.question:
45 is related to 5 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 81 is related to 9. To which of the following is 63 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

45 is related to 5 → 45 ÷ 9 = 5

And,

81 is related to 9 → 81 ÷ 9 = 9

Similarly,

63 is related to → 63 ÷ 9 = 7

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
